Points will be deducted at a rate of 2 points per month if any registration monies are not paid on time. 2. For those questioning League Positions "Points Gained then Frames Won " decides your position in the division. 3. The referee will determine if a total snooker exists. A player can still ask for a ruling but does not need to if it is obvious.

pages.bodyText: ���� �HAVERING & DISTRICT POOL LEAGUE 1. THE GAME The game shall be known as 8 Ball Pool and referred to in these rules as "The Game". It is intended that players and teams should play 8 Ball Pool in the true spirit of the game and in a sportsmanlike manner. It should be clearly understood that the referee is the sole judge of what is fair and unfair play. The referee will take whatever action is necessary to ensure that these rules are observed. 2. REQUIREMENTS OF THE GAME The game is played on a rectangular 6-pocket table with 15 balls plus a cue ball. Balls comprise of two coloured (Red & Yellow) groups, and the 8-ball which is coloured BLACK. Balls in the two groups are known as object balls. 3. OBJECT OF THE GAME The player, or team pocketing all their group of object balls in any order, and then legally pocketing the 8-ball, wins the game. 4. COMMENCEMENT OF THE GAME (OR RE-START) KNOWN AS THE BREAK-OFF The balls are racked as illustrated on the rule sheet with the 8-ball (black) on the 8-ball spot, which is at the intersection of the centre and corner pockets. Order of play is determined by a lag. The winner of the lag has the option of breaking or requesting their opponent to break-off. The opening player plays at the triangle of object balls by striking the cue ball from any position on, or behind, the baulk line. An object ball must be pocketed, or at least TWO object balls must hit any cushion. Failure to do so is a foul break and will result in the balls being re-racked as per rule sheet. The opposing player then starts the game with two visits. If any balls are pocketed from the break the following options apply to the Game; (1) If one or more balls are pocketed of the same colour you can decide to change this colour for another.� If you elect to change to another colour or elect to stay on the original pocketed colour you must �Inform the Referee �. If however you elect to change colour and nominate another you must pocket a Ball from the re-selected colour. Failure to pot a Ball under this circumstance will result in an Open Table for the in-coming player.� (2)� If more than 1 ball was pocketed and they are of a different colour you have to select which colour you wish to play for the continuation of the game. You must �inform the Referee� which colour that is. If you do not pocket a ball of your selected colour you are not penalised with a fou1 because you already own that colour having potted one from the break already. To avoid troubles just tell the referee either-way what colour you will take/be!! If the 8-ball (black) is pocketed from the break-off, the balls will be re-racked and the game will be restarted by the same player. No penalty will be incurred. This applies even if other balls, including the cue ball, are pocketed, or leave the playing surface ("off the table"). If a ball, or balls, are legally pocketed, this entitles the player to one additional shot and this continues until the player either: Fails to pocket one of their own set of allocated balls, or; Commits a foul at any time. Combination shots are allowed, providing the player hits one of their own group first, or any ball with the first shot following any foul (see rule 8(C)). 5. LEGAL SHOTS. 1.� On all shots, the player must: - ��� a)� Cause the Cue Ball's initial contact with a ball to be with a ball "On", and then ��� b)� Pot a ball "On"����� OR; �������� Cause the Cue Ball and or any Object Ball to make contact with a cushion. This must apply to all shots throughout, and UNTIL the game is completed. 2.������ Failure to play a Legal Shot is a Foul and will be penalised with your opponent getting 2 visits. The first shot can, if so desired be taken by playing your opponents ball. (if following a Foul). 3.� EXCEPTIONS: a)� On the Break, the conditions of a Legal Shot do not apply. (See 4 - Commencement of the Game) b)� When playing out of a Total Snooker a player is only obliged to meet the conditions of 1(a) above. i)� Definition: A player is in a Total Snooker when it is impossible to play any part of any of the player's own Colour by way of a "straight line" shot. Leaving an opponent in a Total Snooker is not a foul. ii)� If a player believes that a Total Snooker exists, the player may ask the referee for a ruling. iii) If the referee rules that a Total Snooker exists, the player's obligations under the "Legal Shot" rule are relaxed as follows: - The player need only cause the Cue Ball's initial contact to be with a ball "On".� The requirement to pot a ball and / or cause a ball to strike a cushion is waived. iv)� In a Total Snooker, the straight sections of the cushions DO come into consideration.� If a player has to strike a cushion prior to impact with a �ball on�, then a �Total Snooker� does exist. 4.� INTERPRETATIONS: a)� If the Cue Ball's initial contact is with an Object Ball that is touching a cushion, simply forcing that Object Ball into the same cushion does not constitute a Legal Shot and is punishable as a Foul. Therefore 2 visits are awarded to your opponent. b)� If the Cue Ball and an Object Ball are touching the same cushion, simply forcing the Cue Ball and / or that Object Ball into the same cushion does not constitute a Legal Shot, the same Foul rule applies as in (a) above. � 7. FOULS A. Cue ball pocketed. B. Hitting an opponent�s ball(s) with the cue ball on first impact of the cue ball, except with the first shot following any foul. C. Failing to hit any ball with the cue ball, except where rule 10(C) applies. D. Jump shot - defined as when the cue ball jumps over any part of any ball before making contact with any ball. E. Hitting the 8- ball (black) with the cue ball on first impact of the cue ball before all their own group are pocketed, except with the first shot following any foul. F. Potting any opponent's ball, except with the first shot following any foul. G. Ball off the table. 1. Any object ball or the 8 ball (black), shall be returned to the 8 ball spot (see rule 4(A)), or as near as possible to that spot without touching any other ball, in direct line between that spot and the centre of the string line. 2. If the cue ball, then the cue ball played from in hand (see rule 8(B) general). A ball shall be deemed "off the table" if it comes to rest anywhere other than on the bed of the table. H. If a player's body or clothing should touch any ball. Except the cue ball after the referee calls a "foul", when the player is entitled to the cue ball in hand (see rule 8(B)). I. Player not having at least part of one foot on the floor. J. Playing or touching with the cue any ball other than the cue ball. K. Striking the cue ball with any part of the cue other than the tip. L. Playing out of turn. M. Playing before all balls have come to rest. N. Playing before any ball(s) require re-spotting. O. Striking the cue ball with the cue more than once. P. Push shot - defined as where the cue tip remains in contact with the cue ball for more than the momentary time commensurate with a normal stroked shot, or the cue tip remains in contact with the cue ball once it has commenced it's forward motion. Q. Failing to nominate when balls of both groups are pocketed with the first legal pot. R. Foul break, failing to pot an object ball or drive at least two object balls to hit any cushions. S.�� Any Shot that is not defined as a Legal Shot. �In the event of a Foul, where there is need to have the Cue Ball moved. This must be done at all times by the �Referee�, not by a player!!! 8. PENALTY FOLLOWING ANY FOUL Following any foul, the offending player loses their next visit to the table, giving their opponent two consecutive visits to the table If the cue ball has come to rest on the playing surface, then the player having two visits may proceed to play from where the cue ball lies, or the cue ball may be played from any position on or behind the baulk line. Moving the cue ball in this manner does not count as a shot or visit.� (Players �Must Not� move the Ball , they must ask the �Referee� as in 7(T) above. On the first shot only of the first visit, the oncoming player may, without nomination, play the cue ball on to any ball without penalty, including any opponent's ball(s), or 8-ball (black). If any object ball(s) is pocketed directly, or by combination, the player is deemed to have pocketed a legal ball(s) and continues with the first visit. However, the player must not pot the 8-ball (black), which would mean loss of game, except if the player is on the 8-ball (black), then the game would be won. When the player fails to pot a ball on the first or subsequent shot of the first visit, play then continues with the second visit. The second visit is deemed to have started when the cue ball is struck on the first shot of the second visit. 9. LOSS OF GAME A. If a player pockets the 8-ball (black) before all the balls in their own group, except on the break (see rule 4(D)), the player loses the game. B. A player going in off the 8-ball (black) when the 8-ball (black) is pocketed, loses the game. C. A player pocketing the 8-ball (black) and any other ball on the same shot will lose the game, except when only the 8-ball (black) and ball(s) of the opponents group are on the table, then with the first shot of the first visit following a foul, the player may legally pocket the 8-ball (black) as well as ball(s) of the opponent's group by any combination and in any order. D. A player who clearly fails to make any attempt to play a ball of their own group will lose the game. This is / would be deemed as an �Intentional Foul�. This would be a referee�s decision. E.���� A player placing, or un-screwing his Cue in advance of the completion of the Game. In other words showing quite clearly that they consider their involvement in the game as Over!! 10. GENERAL A. Touching ball. 1. Touching opponent's ball or 8-ball (black), the player MUST play a ball of their own group. Except on the first shot of the first visit following any foul, this entitles the player to any ball. 2. Touching any ball the player is legally entitled to play. The player may choose either; i. Play away from the touching ball and be deemed to have played that ball. Should the cue ball fail to make contact with any ball, or strike the opponents ball, or 8-ball (black), then the shot is fair, no foul. Note, however, that there remains a requirement to drive one or more balls into a cushion. ii. Play to move the touching ball, but great care should be taken not to play a push shot, (foul 7(P)), or contact the cue ball twice, (foul 7(O)). (Moving the object ball is not automatically a foul). B. Cue ball in hand. `When a player has the cue ball in hand, the ball is played from any position on, or behind, the string line, and in any direction. C. Player in control A player is said to be in control of the table from the time their body, cue, or clothing touches the table prior to their shot, throughout the visit, and up until the opponent does likewise prior to their visit. Any ball(s) which fall into pockets during this period, (including the 8-ball (black)) is deemed to have been potted by the player in control. D. Completion of game. The game is completed when the 8-ball (black) is pocketed in any pocket, and all the remaining balls have come to rest, except on the break (see rule 4(D) ). E. Minute Rule. The Minute Rule applies in all DOUBLES frames ONLY and must be rigidly adhered to. The referee should act as time-keeper. Breach of the Minute Rule is a Standard Foul. 2 visits apply. (When does the minute Start?) It starts immediately after the Balls Come to a Standstill, from the previous shot. �REMEMBER THIS IS A �RULE, NOT A SUGGESTION!! F. Talking during doubles After the break, a pair may confer until the in-coming player Touches The Table. From that point players may Not Confer/Talk with each other until their visit ends. After the visit, talking can recommence until the other player comes to the table for their shot. This is repeated for each pair until the game ends. Any proven talking during visits is a standard foul (2 visit penalty), called by the referee. 11. STALEMATE Should any situation arise whereby a legal shot is IMPOSSIBLE to play, then the game shall be restarted by the player who started that frame, whether this situation has been arrived at by accident or design. Known as a �RE-RACK�. If in the opinion of the referee neither player is allowing the game to progress, or a stalemate situation has arisen, then the game shall be restarted by the player who started that frame. The referee shall not allow numerous visits with neither player making any attempt to make the opening pot which decides the playing groups (unless it is felt that progress is being made). If the player who started that frame did so by virtue of their opponent making a foul break, that player will break on any restart with one visit, not the opponent who made the foul break. GUIDANCE The term "SHOT" means striking the cue ball once. The term "VISIT" refers to the one turn at the table comprising of one or a series of shots. The term "BREAK" refers to the first shot of a game, or the first shot of a game being restarted. Coaching is deemed unsportsmanlike behaviour. (see rule 1). A referee may, only if requested, advise on the rules of the game. The �Player in Control� must request a waiver from the referee if he or she believes that they lie in a �Total Snooker�, however apparent it may be. ���������������������������������������������������������������������������������������������������������������������������������������������� �������������������������������� HAVERING DISTRICT POOL RULES ������������������ �(Internal Rules as Opposed to League Rules) ������������� ����������������������������Summer & Winter League Formats. 1.��������� A Team. This shall consist of as many people as you deem fit, and appropriate to yourself. A full & complete Registration Sheet should be given at Commencement of the said Season. The Registration Fee per season is �100.� ������������ Please take account of Match Formats, i.e. 6 x Singles, 3 x Doubles. This means that you Need a Player count of at least 6 players, but suggested minimum of 8 players to cover Holidays. Signing of additional (new) players up to the end of the1st half of a season is �3 per player. 2.��������� Commencement of Match. All games should start as close to 8:30 as is possible to allow for the match to end within Pub/Club opening Hours. If the visiting team has not arrived or is not ready to start by 8.30 a game can be claimed for every fifteen (15) minutes elapsing!!�� (Good Sportsmanship should always be considered). Table Time. It is the responsibility of the Home Team to allow the Visiting Team warm-up time from 8:15 prior to the match starting. Please note: It is the responsibility of All Teams , in All Divisions to have a Cue Rest on Site 3.���������� Match Cancellations. These are not allowed, other than for very good reasons such as Pub/Club Closures, mass sickness, or death etc etc. The committee will decide on any bizarre, or other reasons. Each team will be given 2 jokers per half season. Unused jokers do not carry over. A team with 3/4/5 players must declare at the start of a match that one player is to be selected randomly to play twice in the singles. A different player can then play twice in the doubles where the team has 3 or 5 players. There is no stipulation as to where the selected joker(s) should play. �"JOKERS" can only be used if the team has a player shortage. If they have players on site who are (Signed-Up) and could play you cannot use a Joker!! It is not meant to be an instrument for your own advantage. Should there be an agreed, and acceptable Cancellation it is the responsibility of the Team who made the cancellation to arrange & play the re-arranged match by the end of the said month in which the match was originally programmed. �������������� Failure to do so will mean that the game is forfeited, and points are given to the team who were not responsible for the cancellation. (This Rule is also applicable to all/any K.O.Cup Games) �4.���������� Result Cards.� It is the responsibility of the winning Team to make sure that the card is mailed, to reach the Results Secretary, looking after your League, not later than the Saturday of the week in which the game was played. A 1 point deduction from the overall table will be made if winning signatures are missing from the card. �������������� In current technological times we will accept emailed result cards, not results only. We need the card so that all signatures can be checked for authenticity of registered players. 5.����������� Meetings. These are held on the Second Sunday of every month, currently at the Collier Row Catholic Club. The start time is 11.30. All teams must appoint a Delegate to attend. This person does not have to be the Captain, but must have the power to Vote, if any matters need to be voted on. �������������� (a)�� Failure to attend will mean the payment of a fine, of ��10, payable immediately at the next meeting. �������������� (b)�� Teams will be expelled from the League immediately on missing 3 Meetings. This does not mean 3 consecutive meetings, it means 3 x meetings as an addition, over any period. 6.����������� Disagreements.� Should there be any matches where this applies it is expected that the 2 Captains are in a position to reach an agreed, and satisfactory settlement. ������������� ��If, however, this matter cannot be sorted amicably, the situation should be brought to the next meeting for settlement. Should it be necessary to play the offending game at the meeting Venue then it will be. 7.������������� Time Limit.�� All games are subject to the Rules & Regulations of the Brewery , or Committee running the establishment you are playing in. ����������������� You are therefore requested to be aware of this matter, and any method should be employed to seek that the games ends at a satisfactory time. ������������������ Remember it is the responsibility of the Home Team to see that the game is finished on time and would be the Team who lose out if it�s not. If games are un-played when the venues Rules & Regulations are broken !! the home team would lose any Frame�s unplayed. ���������������� Under No Circumstances !! should any team use this issue to gain an advantage over the match. i.e. intentionally delaying games to reach a balance of game/game�s at the end of the night!!� I�m sure you see my point here!! 8.������������� Ringers � Un-registered Players.�� Any team found using either should be reminded that all games won, using such players would lose all points gained by them. This would be in all categories of the League Format.�� 9.�������������� Disorderly Conduct.� We have a very good record in the main in this area. But should any team be found breaking this rule, subject to investigation, they would be expelled immediately from the League. 10.������������ Food.� It is the responsibility of all Home Teams to provide this. It does not need to be a Banquet, but a satisfactory to cover for refreshment for the evening. ����������������� Should there be a situation where the visiting Team does not arrive, and food has been prepared, then it would be the responsibility of the team who failed to arrive to recompense the Home Team with a payment of �20 for the prepared, un-used food.���� � 11.��� ����������Teams Leaving Who Owe Money.� Where a Team leaves the League, but in doing so leaves owing the League money they, nor any team from that establishment will be allowed to re-join without Full Payment of Monies Owed. This applies to both the Team & Any Player in the Team. ������������������� We will however give consideration to allowing any player from the Team to apply for entrance to another Team, but only on Payment of a Surcharge of �20 per player. This payment will be over & above the usual Team Registration of �60.������ �������������������� By doing this the League will re-coup, at least some lost monies. ���������� ��������� ooooooooooooooooooOoooooooooooooooooooo���

  <p class=MsoNormal><b><span style='font-size:16.0pt;color:green;background:
  yellow;mso-highlight:yellow'><o:p> </o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:green;background:

  <p class=MsoNormal><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:green;background:
  yellow;mso-highlight:yellow'><o:p> </o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white;background:
  green;mso-highlight:green'>1. THE GAME<o:p></o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:green;background:yellow;
  mso-highlight:yellow'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:1'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><span style='font-size:11.0pt;color:black'>The game shall
  be known as 8 Ball Pool and referred to in these rules as "The
  Game". It is intended that players and</span><span style='font-size:
  11.0pt;color:#333333'> teams</span><span style='font-size:11.0pt;color:black'>
  should play 8 Ball Pool in the true spirit of the game and in a sportsmanlike
  manner. It should be clearly understood that the referee is the sole judge of
  what is fair and unfair play. The referee will take whatever action is
  necessary to ensure that these rules are observed.</span><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:2'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><a name=2></a><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'>2.
  REQUIREMENTS OF THE GAME</span></b><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:3'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><span style='font-size:11.0pt;color:black'>The game is
  played on a rectangular 6-pocket table with 15 balls plus a cue ball. Balls
  comprise of two coloured (Red & Yellow) groups, and the 8-ball which is
  coloured BLACK. Balls in the two groups are known as object balls. </span><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:4'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><a name=3></a><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'>3.
  OBJECT OF THE GAME</span></b><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:5'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><span style='font-size:11.0pt;color:black'>The player, or
  team pocketing all their group of object balls in any order, and then legally
  pocketing the 8-ball, wins the game.</span><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:6'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><a name=4></a><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'>4.
  COMMENCEMENT OF THE GAME (OR RE-START) KNOWN AS THE BREAK-OFF</span></b><span
  style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:7'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <ol start=1 type=A>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
       mso-list:l5 level1 lfo1;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><a name=4A></a><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>The balls are racked as illustrated on the rule
       sheet with the 8-ball (black) on the 8-ball spot, which is at the
       intersection of the centre and corner pockets.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
       mso-list:l5 level1 lfo1;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><a name=4B></a><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>Order of play is determined by a lag. The
       winner of the lag has the option of breaking or requesting their
       opponent to break-off.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
       mso-list:l5 level1 lfo1;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><a name=4C></a><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>The opening player plays at the triangle of
       object balls by striking the cue ball from any position on, or behind,
       the baulk line. An object ball must be pocketed, or at least TWO object
       balls must hit any cushion. Failure to do so is a foul break and will
       result in the balls being re-racked as per rule sheet. The opposing
       player then starts the game with two visits.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
       mso-list:l5 level1 lfo1;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><span style='font-size:
       11.0pt'>If any balls are pocketed from the break the following options
       apply to the Game; (<b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>1) </b>If one
       or more balls are pocketed of the same colour you can decide to change
       this colour for another.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>If you
       elect to change to another colour or elect to stay on the original
       pocketed colour you must �Inform the Referee �. If however you elect to
       change colour and nominate another you must pocket a Ball from the
       re-selected colour. Failure to pot a Ball under this circumstance will
       result in an Open Table for the in-coming player<b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:
       normal'>.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>(2)</b><span
       style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>If more than 1 ball was pocketed and
       they are of a different colour you have to select which colour you wish
       to play for the continuation of the game. You must �<b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:
       normal'>inform the Referee� which</b> colour that is. If you do not
       pocket a ball of your selected colour you are not penalised with a fou1
       because you already own that colour having potted one from the break
       already. <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>To avoid troubles just
       tell the referee either-way what colour you will take/be</b>!!<o:p></o:p></span></li>
  </ol>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  <ol start=5 type=A>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
       mso-list:l5 level1 lfo1;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><a name=4D></a><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>If the 8-ball (black) is pocketed from the
       break-off, the balls will be re-racked and the game will be restarted by
       the same player. No penalty will be incurred. This applies even if other
       balls, including the cue ball, are pocketed, or leave the playing
       surface ("off the table").<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
       mso-list:l5 level1 lfo1;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><a name=4E></a><a
       name=4F></a><a name=4G></a><a name=4H></a><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>If
       a ball, or balls, are legally pocketed, this entitles the player to one
       additional shot and this continues until the player either:<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <ol start=1 type=1>
    <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
        mso-list:l5 level2 lfo1;tab-stops:list 72.0pt'><span style='font-size:
        11.0pt'>Fails to pocket one of their own set of allocated balls, or;<o:p></o:p></span></li>
    <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
        mso-list:l5 level2 lfo1;tab-stops:list 72.0pt'><span style='font-size:
        11.0pt'>Commits a foul at any time.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   </ol>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:
       auto;mso-list:l5 level1 lfo1;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><a name=4I></a><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>Combination shots are allowed, providing the
       player hits one of their own group first, or any ball with the first
       shot following any foul (see <a href="http://www.epa.org.uk/rules.php#6C">rule
       8(C)</a>).</span><span style='font-size:10.0pt'> <o:p></o:p></span></li>
  </ol>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:8'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'><o:p> </o:p></span></b></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:9'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt 0cm 36.0pt'><b><span
  style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'><o:p> </o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt 0cm 36.0pt'><b><span
  style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'><o:p> </o:p></span></b></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:10'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'>5. LEGAL
  SHOTS.</span></b><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:11'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'>1.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>On all
  shots, the player must: -<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='margin-left:72.0pt;text-indent:-72.0pt;mso-hyphenate:
  none;tab-stops:-36.0pt 0cm 36.0pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��� </span>a)<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�
  </span>Cause the Cue Ball's initial contact with a ball to be with a ball
  "On", <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span
  style='text-transform:uppercase'>and then</span></b><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��� </span>b)<span
  style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>Pot a ball "On"<span
  style='mso-tab-count:1'>����� </span><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>OR</b>;
  <o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�������� </span>Cause
  the Cue Ball and or any Object Ball to make contact with a cushion. This must
  apply to all shots throughout, and UNTIL the game is completed.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'>2.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������
  </span>Failure to play a Legal Shot is a Foul and will be penalised with your
  opponent getting 2 visits. The first shot can, if so desired be taken by
  playing your <span class=SpellE>opponents</span> ball. (if following a Foul).<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'>3.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span><b
  style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>EXCEPTIONS:<o:p></o:p></b></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='margin-left:72.0pt;text-indent:-72.0pt;mso-hyphenate:
  none;tab-stops:-36.0pt 0cm 36.0pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>a)<span
  style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>On the Break, the conditions of a Legal
  Shot do not apply. (See 4 - Commencement of the Game)<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='margin-left:72.0pt;text-indent:-72.0pt;mso-hyphenate:
  none;tab-stops:-36.0pt 0cm 36.0pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style='margin:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
  normal;tab-stops:14.2pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>b)<span
  style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>When playing out of a Total Snooker a
  player is only obliged to meet the conditions of 1(a) above. <o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style='margin:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
  normal;tab-stops:14.2pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style='margin:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
  normal;tab-stops:1.0cm'><span class=SpellE><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>i</span></span><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'>)<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>Definition:
  A player is in a Total Snooker when it is impossible to play any part of any
  of the player's own Colour by way of a "straight line" shot.
  Leaving an opponent in a Total Snooker is not a foul. <o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style='margin:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
  normal;tab-stops:1.0cm'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>ii)<span
  style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>If a player believes that a Total Snooker
  exists, the player may ask the referee for a ruling. <o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoBodyTextIndent2 style='margin:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
  normal;tab-stops:1.0cm'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>iii) If the referee
  rules that a Total Snooker exists, the player's obligations under the
  "Legal Shot" rule are relaxed as follows: - The player need only
  cause the Cue Ball's initial contact to be with a ball "On".<span
  style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>The requirement to pot a ball and / or
  cause a ball to strike a cushion is waived. <o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:
  -36.0pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>iv)<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�
  </span>In a Total <span style='letter-spacing:-.15pt'>Snooker, the straight
  sections of the cushions DO come into consideration.<span
  style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>If a player has to strike a cushion prior
  to impact with a �ball on�, then a �Total Snooker� does exist.<o:p></o:p></span></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'>4.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span><b
  style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>INTERPRETATIONS:<o:p></o:p></b></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt 0cm 36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'>a)<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>If the Cue
  Ball's initial contact is with an Object Ball that is touching a cushion,
  simply forcing that Object Ball into the same cushion does not constitute a
  Legal Shot and is punishable as a Foul. Therefore 2 visits are awarded to
  your opponent.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-hyphenate:none;tab-stops:-36.0pt 0cm 36.0pt'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'>b)<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>If the Cue
  Ball and an Object Ball are touching the same cushion, simply forcing the Cue
  Ball and / or that Object Ball into the same cushion does not constitute a
  Legal Shot, the same Foul rule applies as in (a) above.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto'><span
  style='font-size:10.0pt'><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�</span><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:12'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>

  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:13'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5A></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>A.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Cue ball
  pocketed.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5B></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>B.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Hitting an
  opponent�s ball(s) with the cue ball on first impact of the cue ball, except
  with the first shot following any foul.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5C></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>C.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Failing to hit
  any ball with the cue ball, except where rule 10(C) applies.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5D></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>D.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Jump shot -
  defined as when the cue ball jumps over any part of any ball before making
  contact with any ball.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5E></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>E.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Hitting the 8-
  ball (black) with the cue ball on first impact of the cue ball before all
  their own group are pocketed, except with the first shot following any foul.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5F></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>F.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Potting any
  opponent's ball, except with the first shot following any foul.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5G></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>G.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Ball off the
  table.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:63.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level2 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 63.0pt'><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>1.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>     
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Any object ball
  or the 8 ball (black), shall be returned to the 8 ball spot (see <a
  href="http://www.epa.org.uk/rules.php#4A">rule 4(A)</a>), or as near as
  possible to that spot without touching any other ball, in direct line between
  that spot and the centre of the string line.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:63.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level2 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 63.0pt'><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>2.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>     
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>If the cue
  ball, then the cue ball played from in hand (see <a
  href="http://www.epa.org.uk/rules.php#8B">rule 8(B)</a> general).<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:36.0pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>A ball shall be deemed
  "off the table" if it comes to rest anywhere other than on the bed
  of the table.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5H></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>H.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>If a player's
  body or clothing should touch any ball. Except the cue ball after the referee
  calls a "foul", when the player is entitled to the cue ball in hand
  (see <a href="http://www.epa.org.uk/rules.php#6B">rule 8(B)</a>).<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5I></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>I.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>      
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Player not
  having at least part of one foot on the floor.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5J></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>J.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>     
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Playing or
  touching with the cue any ball other than the cue ball.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5K></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>K.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Striking the
  cue ball with any part of the cue other than the tip.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5L></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>L.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Playing out of
  turn.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5M></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>M.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>  
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Playing before
  all balls have come to rest.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5N></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>N.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Playing before
  any ball(s) require re-spotting.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5O></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>O.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Striking the
  cue ball with the cue more than once.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5P></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>P.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Push shot -
  defined as where the cue tip remains in contact with the cue ball for more
  than the momentary time commensurate with a normal stroked shot, or the cue
  tip remains in contact with the cue ball once it has commenced it's forward
  motion.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5Q></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>Q.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Failing to
  nominate when balls of both groups are pocketed with the first legal pot.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l3 level1 lfo2;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=5R></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>R.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Foul break,
  failing to pot an object ball or drive at least two object balls to hit any
  cushions.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'>S.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�� </span>Any Shot
  that is not defined as a Legal Shot. <o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�</span><b
  style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>In the event of a Foul, where there is
  need to have the Cue Ball moved. This must be done at all times by the
  �Referee�, not by a player!!!</b><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto'><span
  style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto'><span
  style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:14'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><a name=6></a><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'>8.
  PENALTY FOLLOWING ANY FOUL</span></b><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:15'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <ol start=1 type=A>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
       mso-list:l1 level1 lfo3;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><a name=6A></a><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>Following any foul, the offending player loses
       their next visit to the table, giving their opponent two consecutive
       visits to the table<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
       mso-list:l1 level1 lfo3;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><a name=6B></a><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>If the cue ball has come to rest on the playing
       surface, then the player having two visits may proceed to play from
       where the cue ball lies, or the cue ball may be played from any position
       on or behind the baulk line. Moving the cue ball in this manner does not
       count as a shot or visit.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�
       </span>(Players �Must Not� move the Ball , they must ask the �Referee�
       as in 7(T) above.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:
       auto;mso-list:l1 level1 lfo3;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><a name=6C></a><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>On the first shot only of the first visit, the
       oncoming player may, without nomination, play the cue ball on to any
       ball without penalty, including any opponent's ball(s), or 8-ball
       (black). If any object ball(s) is pocketed directly, or by combination,
       the player is deemed to have pocketed a legal ball(s) and continues with
       the first visit. However, the player must not pot the 8-ball (black),
       which would mean loss of game, except if the player is on the 8-ball
       (black), then the game would be won. When the player fails to pot a ball
       on the first or subsequent shot of the first visit, play then continues
       with the second visit. The second visit is deemed to have started when
       the cue ball is struck on the first shot of the second visit.</span><span
       style='font-size:10.0pt'> <o:p></o:p></span></li>
  </ol>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:16'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><a name=7></a><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'>9.
  LOSS OF GAME</span></b><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:17'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:27.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l4 level1 lfo4;tab-stops:
  list 27.0pt'><a name=7A></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>A.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>If a player
  pockets the 8-ball (black) before all the balls in their own group, except on
  the break (see <a href="http://www.epa.org.uk/rules.php#4D">rule 4(D)</a>),
  the player loses the game.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:27.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l4 level1 lfo4;tab-stops:
  list 27.0pt'><a name=7B></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>B.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>A player going
  in off the 8-ball (black) when the 8-ball (black) is pocketed, loses the
  game.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:27.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l4 level1 lfo4;tab-stops:
  list 27.0pt'><a name=7C></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>C.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>A player
  pocketing the 8-ball (black) and any other ball on the same shot will lose
  the game, except when only the 8-ball (black) and ball(s) of the opponents
  group are on the table, then with the first shot of the first visit following
  a foul, the player may legally pocket the 8-ball (black) as well as ball(s)
  of the opponent's group by any combination and in any order.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:27.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l4 level1 lfo4;tab-stops:
  list 27.0pt'><a name=7D></a><![if !supportLists]><b><span style='font-size:
  11.0pt'><span style='mso-list:Ignore'>D.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span></b><![endif]><b><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>A player
  who clearly fails to make any attempt to play a ball of their own group will
  lose the game. This is / would be deemed as an �Intentional Foul�. This would
  be a referee�s decision.<o:p></o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:18.0pt'><b><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>E.<span
  style='mso-spacerun:yes'>���� </span>A player placing, or un-screwing his Cue
  in advance of the completion of the Game. In other words showing quite
  clearly that they consider their involvement in the game as Over!!<o:p></o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:18.0pt'><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></b></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:18'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><a name=8></a><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'>10.
  GENERAL<o:p></o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:19'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo5;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=8A></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>A.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Touching ball.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:54.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level2 lfo5;tab-stops:
  list 54.0pt'><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>1.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>     
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Touching
  opponent's ball or 8-ball (black), the player MUST play a ball of their own
  group. Except on the first shot of the first visit following any foul, this
  entitles the player to any ball.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:54.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level2 lfo5;tab-stops:
  list 54.0pt'><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>2.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>     
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Touching any
  ball the player is legally entitled to play. The player may choose either;<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:90.0pt;text-indent:-90.0pt;mso-text-indent-alt:-18.0pt;
  mso-list:l0 level3 lfo5;tab-stops:list 90.0pt'><![if !supportLists]><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><span style='mso-list:Ignore'><span
  style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>                                   
  </span>i.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>         
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Play away from
  the touching ball and be deemed to have played that ball. Should the cue ball
  fail to make contact with any ball, or strike the opponents ball, or 8-ball
  (black), then the shot is fair, no foul. Note, however, that there remains a
  requirement to drive one or more balls into a cushion. <o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:90.0pt;text-indent:-90.0pt;mso-text-indent-alt:-18.0pt;
  mso-list:l0 level3 lfo5;tab-stops:list 90.0pt'><![if !supportLists]><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><span style='mso-list:Ignore'><span
  style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>                                 
  </span>ii.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>         
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Play to move
  the touching ball, but great care should be taken not to play a push shot, (<a
  href="http://www.epa.org.uk/rules.php#5P">foul 7(P)</a>), or contact the cue
  ball twice, (<a href="http://www.epa.org.uk/rules.php#5O">foul 7(O)</a>).
  (Moving the object ball is not automatically a foul). <o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo5;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=8B></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>B.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Cue ball in
  hand. </span><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><br>
  `When a player has the cue ball in hand, the ball is played from any position
  on, or behind, the string line, and in any direction.</span><span
  style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;margin-bottom:12.0pt;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo5;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=8C></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>C.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>    
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Player in
  control<br>
  <br>
  A player is said to be in control of the table from the time their body, cue,
  or clothing touches the table prior to their shot, throughout the visit, and
  up until the opponent does likewise prior to their visit. Any ball(s) which
  fall into pockets during this period, (including the 8-ball (black)) is
  deemed to have been <span class=SpellE>potted</span> by the player in
  control.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo5;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><a name=8D></a><![if !supportLists]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span
  style='mso-list:Ignore'>D.<span style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>   
  </span></span></span><![endif]><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Completion of
  game.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:18.0pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>The game is completed when
  the 8-ball (black) is pocketed in any pocket, and all the remaining balls
  have come to rest, except on the break (see <a
  href="http://www.epa.org.uk/rules.php#4D">rule 4(D)</a> ). <o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:18.0pt'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:18.0pt;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo5;tab-stops:
  list 18.0pt'><![if !supportLists]><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'><span style='mso-list:Ignore'>E.<span
  style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>     </span></span></span></b><![endif]><b
  style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Minute
  Rule.<br>
  <br>
  The Minute Rule applies in all DOUBLES frames ONLY and must be rigidly
  adhered to. The referee should act as time-keeper. Breach of the Minute Rule
  is a Standard Foul. 2 visits apply. (When does the minute Start?) It starts
  immediately after the <u>Balls Come to a Standstill</u>, from the previous
  shot. <o:p></o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:18.0pt'><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span
  style='font-size:11.0pt'>�REMEMBER THIS IS A �RULE, NOT A SUGGESTION!!<o:p></o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:
  auto;margin-left:18.0pt;mso-add-space:auto;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo5;
  tab-stops:list 18.0pt'><![if !supportLists]><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:
  normal'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><span style='mso-list:Ignore'>F.<span
  style='font:7.0pt "Times New Roman"'>     </span></span></span></b><![endif]><b
  style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>Talking
  during doubles<o:p></o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;
  mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;margin-left:18.0pt;mso-add-space:auto'><b
  style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoListParagraphCxSpLast style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:
  auto;margin-left:18.0pt;mso-add-space:auto'><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:
  normal'><span style='font-size:11.0pt'>After the break, a pair may confer
  until the in-coming player <u>Touches The Table</u>. From that point players
  may Not Confer/Talk with each other until their visit ends. After the visit,
  talking can recommence until the other player comes to the table for their
  shot. This is repeated for each pair until the game ends. Any proven talking
  during visits is a standard foul (2 visit penalty), called by the referee. <o:p></o:p></span></b></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal style='mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
  margin-left:18.0pt'><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:20'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><a name=9></a><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;color:white'>11.
  STALEMATE</span></b><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:21'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><span style='font-size:11.0pt;color:black'>Should any
  situation arise whereby a legal shot is IMPOSSIBLE to play, then the game
  shall be restarted by the player who started that frame, whether this
  situation has been arrived at by accident or design. Known as a �RE-RACK�.<br>
  <br>
  If in the opinion of the referee neither player is allowing the game to
  progress, or a stalemate situation has arisen, then the game shall be
  restarted by the player who started that frame. The referee shall not allow
  numerous visits with neither player making any attempt to make the opening
  pot which decides the playing groups (unless it is felt that progress is
  being made). If the player who started that frame did so by virtue of their opponent
  making a foul break, that player will break on any restart with one visit,
  not the opponent who made the foul break.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
  <p class=MsoNormal><span style='font-size:11.0pt'><o:p> </o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:22'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;background:#008800;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <p class=MsoNormal><a name=GUIDANCE></a><b><span style='font-size:10.0pt;
  color:white'>GUIDANCE</span></b><span style='font-size:10.0pt'><o:p></o:p></span></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
 <tr style='mso-yfti-irow:23;mso-yfti-lastrow:yes'>
  <td width="100%" style='width:100.0%;padding:3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt 3.75pt'>
  <ul style='margin-top:0cm' type=disc>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-list:l2 level1 lfo6;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>The term "SHOT" means striking the
       cue ball once.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-list:l2 level1 lfo6;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>The term "VISIT" refers to the one
       turn at the table comprising of one or a series of shots.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-list:l2 level1 lfo6;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>The term "BREAK" refers to the first
       shot of a game, or the first shot of a game being restarted.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-list:l2 level1 lfo6;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>Coaching is deemed unsportsmanlike behaviour.
       (see <a href="http://www.epa.org.uk/rules.php#1">rule 1</a>).<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-list:l2 level1 lfo6;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>A referee may, only if requested, advise on the
       rules of the game.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
   <li class=MsoNormal style='mso-list:l2 level1 lfo6;tab-stops:list 36.0pt'><span
       style='font-size:11.0pt'>The �Player in Control� must request a waiver
       from the referee if he or she believes that they lie in a �Total
       Snooker�, however apparent it may be.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
  </ul>
  </td>
 </tr>
</table>

green;mso-highlight:green'>HAVERING DISTRICT POOL RULES</span></b><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span style='font-size:16.0pt'> <o:p></o:p></span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span
style='font-size:20.0pt'><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������������������
</span></span><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�</span>(Internal Rules as Opposed
to League Rules)<o:p></o:p></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������������� </span><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>����������������������������</span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Summer & Winter League Formats.<o:p></o:p></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>1.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��������� </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>A Team. </b>This shall consist of as many
people as you deem fit, and appropriate to yourself. A full & complete
Registration Sheet should be given at Commencement of the said Season. The</p>

<p class=MsoNormal>Registration Fee per season is <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:
normal'>�100.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������������ </span>Please
take account of Match Formats, i.e. <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>6 x
Singles, 3 x Doubles</b>. This means that you</p>

<p class=MsoNormal>Need a Player count of at least 6 players, but suggested
minimum of 8 players to cover Holidays. </p>

<p class=MsoNormal><b><span style='font-family:"Arial",sans-serif;color:#26282A'>Signing
of additional (new) players</span></b><span style='font-family:"Arial",sans-serif;
color:#26282A'> up to the end of the1st half of a season is �3 per player.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>2.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��������� </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Commencement of Match</b>. All games should
start as close to <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>8:30</b> as is
possible to allow for the match to end within Pub/Club opening Hours. If the
visiting team has not arrived or is not ready to start by <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:
normal'>8.30</b> a game can be claimed for every fifteen (15) minutes
elapsing!!<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�� </span>(Good Sportsmanship should
always be considered). <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Table Time.</b>
It is the responsibility of the Home Team to allow the Visiting Team warm-up
time from <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>8:15</b> prior to the match
starting.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal>Please note:<span style='font-family:"Segoe UI",sans-serif'>
It is the responsibility of All Teams , in All Divisions to have a Cue Rest on
Site</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>3.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>���������� </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Match Cancellations</b>. These are not
allowed, other than for very good reasons such as Pub/Club Closures, mass
sickness, or death etc <span class=SpellE>etc</span>. The committee will decide
on any bizarre, or other reasons. Each team will be given 2 jokers per half season.
Unused jokers do not carry over. A team with 3/4/5 players must declare at the
start of a match that one player is to be selected randomly to play twice in
the singles. A different player can then play twice in the doubles where the
team has 3 or 5 players.<span style='font-family:"Arial",sans-serif'> There is
no stipulation as to where the selected joker(s) should play. </span><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�</span>"JOKERS" can only be used if the
team has a player shortage. If they have players on site who are (Signed-Up) and
could play you cannot use a Joker!! It is not meant to be an instrument for
your own advantage.  Should there be an agreed, and acceptable
Cancellation it is the responsibility of the Team who made the cancellation to
arrange & play the re-arranged match by the end of the said month in which
the match was originally programmed.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�������������� </span>Failure
to do so will mean that the game is forfeited, and points are given to the team
who were not responsible for the cancellation. (<b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:
normal'>This Rule is also applicable to all/any <span class=SpellE>K.O.Cup</span>
Games</b>)</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�</span>4.<span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>���������� </span><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Result
Cards</b>.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>It is the responsibility of
the winning Team to make sure that the card is mailed, to reach the Results
Secretary, looking after your League, not later than the Saturday of the week
in which the game was played. <b>A 1 point deduction from the overall table
will be made if winning signatures are missing from the card.<o:p></o:p></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�������������� </span>In
current technological times we will accept emailed result cards, not results only.
We need the card so that all signatures can be checked for authenticity of
registered players.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>5.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>����������� </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Meetings.</b> These are held on the Second
Sunday of every month, currently at the Collier Row Catholic Club. The start
time is 11.30. All teams must appoint a Delegate to attend. This person does
not have to be the Captain, but must have the power to Vote, if any matters
need to be voted on.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��������������
</span>(a)<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�� </span>Failure to attend will mean
the payment of a fine, of <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�</span>�10, payable immediately at the next meeting. <o:p></o:p></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><o:p> </o:p></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�������������� </span></b>(b)<span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�� </span>Teams will be expelled from the League
immediately on missing 3 Meetings. This does not mean 3 consecutive meetings,
it means 3 x meetings as an addition, over any period.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>6.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>����������� </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Disagreements.</b><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>Should there be any matches where this
applies it is expected that the 2 Captains are in a position to reach an
agreed, and satisfactory settlement.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������������� </span><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��</span>If, however, this matter cannot be sorted
amicably, the situation should be brought to the next meeting for settlement.
Should it be necessary to play the offending game at the meeting Venue then it
will be.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>7.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������������� </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Time Limit.<span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�� </span></b>All games are subject to the Rules &
Regulations of the Brewery , or Committee running the establishment you are
playing in.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>����������������� </span>You
are therefore requested to be aware of this matter, and any method should be
employed to seek that the games ends at a satisfactory time.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������������������
</span>Remember it is the responsibility of the Home Team to see that the game
is finished on time and would be the Team who lose out if it�s not. If games
are un-played when the venues Rules & Regulations are broken !! the home
team would lose any Frame�s unplayed.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>���������������� </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Under No Circumstances !!</b> should any
team use this issue to gain an advantage over the match. i.e. intentionally
delaying games to reach a balance of game/game�s at the end of the night!!<span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>I�m sure you see my point here!!</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>8.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������������� </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Ringers � Un-registered Players.</b><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�� </span>Any team found using either should be
reminded that all games won, using such players would lose all points gained by
them. This would be in all categories of the League Format.<span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�� </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>9.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�������������� </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Disorderly Conduct.</b><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>We have a very good record in the main in
this area. But should any team be found breaking this rule, subject to
investigation, they would be expelled immediately from the League.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>10.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������������ </span><b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Food.</b><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�
</span>It is the responsibility of all Home Teams to provide this. It does not
need to be a Banquet, but a satisfactory to cover for refreshment for the
evening.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�����������������
</span>Should there be a situation where the visiting Team does not arrive, and
food has been prepared, then it would be the responsibility of the team who
failed to arrive to recompense the Home Team with a payment of <b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>�20</b> for the prepared, un-used
food.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>���� </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>�</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal>11.<span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��� </span><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>����������</span><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>Teams
Leaving Who Owe Money.</b><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>� </span>Where a Team
leaves the League, but in doing so leaves owing the League money they, nor any
team from that establishment will be allowed to re-join without Full Payment of
Monies Owed. This applies to both the Team & Any Player in the Team.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������������������� </span>We
will however give consideration to allowing any player from the Team to apply
for entrance to another Team, but only on Payment of a Surcharge of <b
style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>�20 per player</b>. This payment will be
over & above the usual Team Registration of <b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:
normal'>�60.</b><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>������ </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��������������������
</span>By doing this the League will re-coup, at least some lost monies.</p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>���������� </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��������� </span><span
class=SpellE><b style='mso-bidi-font-weight:normal'>ooooooooooooooooooOoooooooooooooooooooo</b></span><span
style='mso-spacerun:yes'>��� </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><o:p> </o:p></p>
